# Extension API reference

<!-- Generated by cargo test -p axo --test ext_reference; do not edit. -->

Extensions are trusted code; nothing here is a sandbox.

## session

| Method | Parameters | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| path |  | The session file. With lazy creation it exists only after the first submission. |
| spawnLink |  | The spawn link of a child session; None for root sessions and forks. |
| agent |  | The current root persona or the definition this child was spawned with. |
| model |  | The currently selected model. |
| thinking |  | The thinking level applied to the current model. |
| serviceTier |  | The chosen service tier; it applies only on models that support it. |
| effectiveServiceTier |  | The tier requests are sent with on the current model. |
| config |  | The effective configuration for this session. |
| setName | name? | Sets the file-wide session name; newlines become spaces and blank names clear it. May be called while a run is active; this entry contributes no context message. |
| name |  | The latest session name in file order, independent of the selected branch. |
| skills |  | The skills in force now; the prompt's catalog and /name commands use these. |
| agents |  | Agent and team definitions in force now. |
| diagnostics |  | Start-time context, skill, prompt, and scheme diagnostics, also logged as warnings. |
| jobs |  | The background jobs read proc:// lists (promoted, retained and rebuilt, finished ones included), ascending. |
| killJob | id | Stops job id (bg_N or agent_N), reporting whether it was running. |
| commandJobs | callId | The job ids of the commands a tool call started, oldest first, foreground commands included. |
| background | callId | Requests promotion of every foreground command the call started. A command that finishes first stays foreground. |
| tools |  | The tools this session exposes: direct ones in prompt order, then deferred catalog entries. Reading it promotes nothing. |
| commands |  | The commands a host may offer: built-ins, modes, registered commands, then unhidden skills. |
| modes |  | The mode definitions in force now; empty for children. |
| keywords |  | Every keyword definition in force now, disabled ones included; empty for children. |
| keywordMatches | text | The keywords that would fire in text typed as a message right now, as byte ranges into text. A leading /command token is skipped, as on submission. |
| runCommand | command | Runs a command under its policy: model/thinking/tier, modes and registered commands alongside a turn, compact/shake/navigate only when idle (Error::Busy otherwise). |
| abort |  | Stops the active run (CancelReason::User). Stopping an active run holds queued input and job results until the user's next input or resume_wakes; input sent after the Stop starts the next run once this one settles. An idle Stop changes nothing. |
| setModel | model | Switches the model from the next request; the thinking level is clamped to it. |
| setAgent | name? | Switches the root persona from the next request, applying its model selector when present. Changing the system prompt and tools is cache-heavy on models without mid-conversation system-message and tool changes. |
| setThinking | level | Sets the thinking level from the next request, clamped to the model; returns the level applied. |
| setServiceTier | tier | Chooses the service tier from the next request; returns the tier the current model applies. |
| answer | callId, answers | Settles the pending question of tool call call_id. |
| dismiss | callId | Dismisses a pending question or mode result; the run is cancelled. |
| contextUsage |  | The current estimated context size and effective compaction limits. |
| isRunning |  | Whether a run, maintenance or navigation currently owns the session. Observing idle does not reserve it against future submissions or background wakes. |
| treeUsage |  | This session's own recorded spend plus every descendant's, maintenance included; SessionEvent::TreeUsage reports changes. |
| prompt | input | Expands a /skill args invocation, saves the submission and runs the prompt; returns when the run settles. Error::Busy while a run is active (use steer/follow_up). Prompt text never runs a built-in command: hosts that offer typed commands parse them with Command::parse and call run_command. |
| promptWith | request | prompt, deduplicated by request_id: a request id that was already submitted returns its earlier submission and starts nothing, even while that run is active. |
| steer | input | Saves and queues a user message delivered after the current tool calls finish; on an idle session it starts a run. |
| followUp | input | Saves and queues a user message delivered when the active run would otherwise end; on an idle session it starts a run. |
| withdraw | submissionId | Takes a queued steer or follow-up back before it is delivered and returns it for the host to edit and resubmit. Error::NotQueued once it was delivered or withdrawn. |
| resumeWakes |  | Lifts the pause a Stop or a failed run left and, on an idle session, starts a run with the held steers or follow-ups, else with pending job results and mail. |
| post | message | Posts a durable host message with the requested delivery timing. |
| appendCustom | customType, data? | Appends branch-scoped state under the caller's custom type and returns the journal entry. |
| custom | customType | Returns the latest value for the caller's custom type on the current branch, or null. |
| spawn | request | Spawns one child and returns its receipt. |
| spawnTeam | request | Spawns a team and returns its receipt. |
| parseCommand | text | Parses a slash command; returns null for ordinary input. |
| readSnapshot | sha256 | Reads the verified bytes of a session snapshot as base64. |
| commandOutput | callId, offset, limit | Reads up to one MiB of raw output from the call's newest command at a byte offset. |
| commandChunks | callId, offset, limit | Reads up to one MiB from the call's newest command, labeled by stream, at a byte offset. |
| jobOutput | jobId, offset, limit | Reads up to one MiB of raw output from a job at a byte offset. |
| jobChunks | jobId, offset, limit | Reads up to one MiB from a job, labeled by stream, at a byte offset. |
| entries | after?, limit? | Reads journal entries after a sequence number (default 256, clamped to 1..=1024). |
| live |  | Takes a snapshot of the current live session state. |
| compact | focus? | Summarizes eligible history without submitting an ordinary user turn; focus tells the summary what to prioritize (blank focus counts as none). |
| shake | mode | Removes eligible blocks into recoverable session artifacts, without model calls. |
| navigate | target?, options | Moves the session's position to target (None = before the first entry). Without options.summarize this appends a leaf entry; with it, the abandoned branch is summarized first (steered by options.focus) and a branch_summary entry at target replaces the leaf. The next prompt continues from there with the live model and thinking level, recorded on the branch when it implies others. |
| setMode | name? | Selects a root-session mode; instructions and limits take effect at the next request boundary. |
| mode |  | The selected mode, including a selection waiting for the next request boundary. |
| effectiveMode |  | The mode applied at the latest request boundary, not a pending selection. |
| acceptResult | callId, options | Accepts a review, optionally replacing its value and continuation. Invalid replacements leave the review pending. |
| reviseResult | callId, feedback | Keeps the mode active and asks the model to revise its result. |
| renderSkill | name, args | Renders a discovered skill with command arguments, including skills hidden from the model. |
| inspectPrompt |  | Inspects local builder and recorded prompt state without rebuilding or I/O. |
| contextFiles |  | Inspects loaded startup files and recorded nested blocks, never rereading disk. This is not the set of files guaranteed to appear in a provider request. |
| fileLedger |  | Read-only copy of recorded full-file hashes, keyed by canonical file path. |
| squashChanges | changes | The net change per file across changes, re-diffed from this session's blobs. |
| reloadExecEnv |  | Drops the cached project environment and resolves it again now. When its prompt note or the date changed, the prompt diff reaches the model before its next request. |
| send | to, message, steer | Routes exactly like the model's send: owned child id, teammate name, or parent. The receipt identifies the saved submission or parent result message. |

## tools

| Method | Parameters | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cwd |  | The working directory for tool paths and commands. |
| readFile | path | Reads a filesystem or scheme resource as UTF-8 text. |
| readFileBytes | path | Reads a filesystem or scheme resource as base64 bytes. |
| writeFile | path, content | Writes text using the session's write scope and freshness guard. |
| writeFileBytes | path, content | Writes base64 bytes using the session's write scope and freshness guard. |
| runCommand | request | Runs a supervised bash command in this invocation's context. |
| rewriteUrls | command | Rewrites scheme URLs in a command to their filesystem paths. |
| parseUrl | input | Parses a path as a registered scheme URL. |
| exactUrl | text | Recognizes an exact registered scheme URL. |
| schemeContext |  | The session facts passed to scheme handlers. |
| promptDocs |  | The registered schemes' prompt documentation. |
| ledger |  | The paths and content hashes currently in the session's file ledger. |
| recorded | path | Returns the last recorded hash for a file, resolving the path as readFile does. |
| readSnapshot | sha256 | Reads verified snapshot bytes as base64. |
| attachContext | path | Attaches newly encountered nested project instructions for a file. |
| artifactDir |  | The directory containing the session's artifacts. |
| allocateArtifact | tail | Reserves a numbered artifact path without creating the file. |
| findArtifact | id | Finds a session artifact by numeric id. |
| liveArtifacts |  | Lists artifact paths still owned by writers, sorted by path. |
| steerPending |  | Whether steering input is pending for this invocation. |
| steered |  | Waits until steering input is pending. |
| invocation |  | The session-local invocation id for this tool execution. |
| sessionId |  | The id of the session these tools belong to. |
| bashAccess |  | The bash access of the session's current scope (agent, mode and child ceiling). |
| locate | path | Cleans and resolves a scheme URL or ordinary filesystem path. |
| resolvePath | path | A tool's path argument as an absolute path (pi resolveToCwd): unicode spaces become plain spaces, a leading @ is dropped, ~/~/ expand to $HOME, file:// URLs become paths, relative paths join cwd, and ./.. are folded. |
| writeScope |  | The session's current effective write scope (agent, mode and child ceiling); None: unrestricted. |
| checkWrite | target | Refuses a target outside any layer of the write scope. write and edit call it; host tools that mutate files must too. File-backed targets compare by real path (file_key), so a symlink inside an allowed directory, dangling or not, cannot escape it. The check is point-in-time, not containment against a concurrent process swapping symlinks. Virtual targets match only URL entries. |

## host

| Method | Parameters | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| squashChanges | session, changes | SnapshotStore::squash over a session file's blobs: the net change per file across changes. Takes no lock. |
| listSessions | cwd | Sessions started in cwd, most recently modified first. |
| readSession | path, after?, limit? | Reads a saved session after a sequence number (default 256 entries, clamped to 1..=1024). |
| readSnapshot | session, sha256 | Reads a verified snapshot blob as base64. |
| catalog | cwd, projectAccess? | Resolves configuration and file-based definitions without opening a session. |
| validCommandName | name | Tests whether a command name is valid. |
| validSectionName | name | Tests whether a prompt section name is valid. |
| validSchemeName | name | Tests whether a scheme name is valid. |
| parseCommand | text | Parses a slash command; returns null for ordinary input. |
| decodeCommand | name, args | Decodes a named command and its JSON arguments. |
| parseAgent | defaultName, markdown | Parses an agent definition and returns its diagnostics. |
| parseMode | defaultName, markdown | Parses a mode definition and returns its diagnostics. |
| parseKeyword | defaultName, markdown | Parses a keyword definition and returns its diagnostics. |
| jobsFromEntries | header, entries | Reconstructs job information from a journal. |
| project | entries, leaf? | Projects a journal onto the path ending at the requested leaf. |
| squash | changes | Combines changes into a net change per file. |
| fileChanges | result | Extracts the file changes recorded by a tool result. |
| gitRoot | cwd | Finds the nearest ancestor with a git repository. |
| projectRoot | cwd | Returns the git root or the given directory outside a repository. |
| homeAgentsDir |  | Returns the user's shared agents directory when a home directory is available. |
| parseCommandArgs | input | Splits command argument text into arguments. |
| substituteArgs | template, args | Substitutes command arguments into a template. |

## Served by the extension bridge

- session: subscribe.
- host: session lifecycle methods (create, open, fork, close), typed as HostLifecycle in the SDK bindings. Without a lifecycle hook, these calls are refused with no_lifecycle.
- models: stream.
